newsitem.title: USA: Resource Mortgage Capital says to change name.
newsitem.headline: Resource Mortgage Capital says to change name.

text.p: Resource Mortgage Capital Inc said on Thursday that its shareholders had approved a proposal to change the company's name to Dynex Capital Inc.
"We believe the new name will help the company establish greater 'brand' recognition, as we currently use the Dynex name in most of our lending activities," said company president Thomas Potts.

The new trading symbols for the company will be 'DX' for the common stock, 'DXCPP' for the Series A preferred stock, 'DXCPO' for the Series B preferred stock and 'DXCPN' for the Series C preferred stock, the company said.
The stocks will begin trading under their new symbols on April 28, it added.
Resource Mortgage is a mortgage and consumer finance company.
